sources.fact: Learn dataset actions includes distinct header and download GET actions. Form action /cgi-bin/tap_proxy accepts ID, service=header, debug=debug for URL-only mode, server=ops. Demo includes both an ADP HARPS product and a HARPS raw example.

URL-only validation with official demo ID returned HTTP 200, Content-Type text/plain; charset=UTF-8, 61 response bytes, naming https://archive.eso.org/hdr?DpId=ADP.2014-10-01T10:19:21.580 . No redirect followed and no actual product header requested.
Phase 3 dataset ID corresponds to ARCFILE without extension. Its ADP timestamp is archival, not observation time. Product versions may be current, obsolete, or deprecated.
ESO 1D spectrum product has primary header plus one binary-table extension. Main selection metadata are in primary; spectral arrays are in extension data.
ESO describes a FITS header viewer available from archive query HDR links. This supports a header display route but does not guarantee its current MIME type or HDU subset.

Official HARPS Radial Velocities Catalog DR1 schema includes adp_dpid, raw_dpid, date_obs, mjd_obs, exptime and drs_berv in km/s. Advertised 289843 records/6488 objects, 2003-09-19 through 2023-05-30. Useful unqueried future metadata lead; no target catalogue requests were made.
